item.title: Show HN: Build system that lives in your project
item.summary: Hi everyone! I'd like to introduce Autark https://autark.dev This is a simple build system that lives entirely in your project and bootstraps itself before building the project itself. I'd really appreciate feedback from the community. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49429201 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
